title: Kissed with Dashi Indian Chicken Curry
description: Umami-rich Indian chicken curry infused with rich dashi extract and flavorful jam3n ib rico, perfect for a lazy Sunday evening. This dish is Shojin-friendly, meaning it adheres to Zen Buddhist culinary principles of simplicity and mindfulness.

ingredients.name: Dashi extract, 2 tablespoons
ingredients.notes: Homemade or store-bought dashi powder can be used in a pinch.

ingredients.name: Korean chili flakes (gochugaru), 1/4 teaspoon
ingredients.notes: For added heat, adjust to taste.

instructions: Heat butter in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned, about 6 minutes.
Add minced ginger and cook for 1 minute more.
Add chicken and cook until browned on all sides and cooked through, about 10 minutes.
Stir in dashi extract, garam masala, ground cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper. Simmer for 2 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld.
Stir in grated jam3n ib rico and cook for an additional minute.
Serve the chicken and sauce over basmati rice or with naan bread, garnished with chopped cilantro and a sprinkle of Korean chili flakes, if desired.
